best_model.name: Random Forest Regressor
best_model.explanation: Random Forest Regressor was automatically selected as AniTaya's primary production model after evaluating 8 regression algorithms on 5,186 unseen holdout test records and 5-Fold Cross-Validation. It achieved the highest Test R² of 0.9729 (97.29% variance explained) and a 5-Fold Cross-Validation R² of 0.9447 (±0.0047), with a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 6,437.66 hg/ha (0.64 MT/ha) and RMSE of 13,913.27 hg/ha (1.39 MT/ha) in 4.15s of training. It outperformed the runner-up Extra Trees Regressor (Test R² = 0.9621, RMSE = 16,467.66 hg/ha) and improved accuracy by +22.24 percentage points over the Linear Regression baseline while reducing MAE by 78.4%. Feature importance analysis confirms that Crop Type (item) (60.27%) and Country / Region (area) (20.39%) are the strongest drivers of harvest yield.
